svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Lodge exterior elevations
svg.desc: Four elevations of Common lodge at one scale. Top of roof 4.96 m above grade, finished floor 0.64 m above grade on piles. Timber rainscreen over continuous external insulation; 26 exterior openings; screened porch and covered entry deck; 2 ramp(s) at 1:15; 25 PV modules drawn as individual tilted panels. Not engineered.

g.text: Elevations • conceptual • not engineered • drawn to the same scale as the plan
Cladding boards, openings and foundations are shown diagrammatically. PV is drawn flat: tilt and racking are not designed.
Grade is assumed level for these drawings; the site model has real slopes and the pile heights will vary.
